text: Recording must be **guaranteed**; notification may be **best-effort**. These were conflated, which is why #6 and #7 happened. Concretely: a command notifies its caller **only when it FINISHES**, so a monitor that loops forever **can never notify**. Notification therefore has to be either a desktop notification (fires from the recording process) or a **bounded, re-armable poll** whose completion is the wake-up.
